children.value: > Fact From Story The All Blacks are playing for themselves as much as anyone – and the generation of players and leaders that will call time on their international careers at week’s end.
> > Fact From Story The backlash and toxicity that followed their historic home series loss to Ireland was a humbling and public reminder of the expectation of being an All Black.

> > > Fact From Story The pain of the days and weeks after that dark July, as well as the bumps and bruises along the way, including as recently as August when they suffered their biggest defeat to the Boks to lose the inaugural and prestigious Qatar Cup, still runs deep.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge People want to avoid pain.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Players want to avoid the backlash of losing.
> Commonsense Knowledge Players nearing the end of their careers will want to win for themselves.
